analysis.title: FX Divergence: More Room for the Dollar
key_insights: G10 FX Macro Implied Fair Value Model shows EURUSD cheap at -1.0σ and USDSEK rich at +0.5σ. Longer-window specifications leave more room for USD strength as central-bank paths diverge, with the largest gaps in NOK, AUD and SEK.

The median G10 currency is down 260bp against the USD over ten trading days, below the 10th percentile of ten-day returns over the past decade. Carry and equity performance drove returns, which points to a genuine risk unwind.

USD-long positioning still looks light. UBS FX Flow Monitor shows ten-day cumulative flows at only +0.7σ for hedge funds and +0.3σ for asset managers, and risk-reversal positioning is below its five-year average.
The USD rally was fueled by inflation and Fedspeak. A further leg higher needs validation from activity data and wider US rate differentials.
The model's 100% short-USD output is generated mechanically by the cross-sectional framework and is not a discretionary USD view.

Longer-run specification implied spot suggests USDNOK +5.1%, AUDUSD -2.6%, USDSEK +2.0%. Where baseline and longer-run models disagree, the author applies a higher hurdle before acting on the tactical signal.

Thanksgiving week data includes 3Q26 GDP revision, October PCE, personal income/spending and capital goods orders. These could revive upward pressure on US rates. UBSe sees GDP revised up +0.6% (4.0% annualized), and nowcasts point to solid growth.
UBSe expects October PCE headline +33bps and core +30bps m/m, for 12-month changes of 3.80% and 3.22%. US 1y1y inflation swaps at 2.33% (-1.7σ) trade low versus WTI at $83/bbl.

Canada: UBS Economics still expects a 25bp BoC hike in December despite October CPI missing (headline 3.1% vs 3.2% est, core 1.8% vs 2.0% est). The BoC paper 'Act Now or Wait' concluded unnecessary tightening costs less than delayed tightening, which supports the pay CAD December OIS position.

Australia: AUD has fallen more than five big figures in under 60 trading days and spot is below 0.6650. Not fading the downtrend is advised, and October CPI is unlikely to reignite AUD longs. UBS Economics sees a 25bp RBA cut by August 2027.

Tactical views: long EUR mean reversion held with EUR near 1.0950, and long USDZAR closed after about 200bps ahead of the SARB decision. Receive US 1y1y gained 32bp last week and pay CAD December OIS entered at 15bps is held.

Equity stress: over ten sessions SPX, NDX and RTY fell 8.6%, 10.4% and 7.5%. Cyclicals underperformed defensives by 9%, 10y real yields fell 13bp, and CCC OAS widened 188bp to nearly 1,200bp, resembling an equity-led growth scare.

Drawdown depth: rolling one-year max drawdowns are SPX -11.6%, NDX -19.8%, RTY -15.9%, near the most severe decile of 20 years. Time-normalized intensity ranks near the 95th, 99th and 85th percentiles.
